questions.question: How do you greet someone in the afternoon?
questions.explanation: "Buenas tardes" is used from about noon until evening.

questions.instruction: Match the Spanish with the English

questions.question: "Mucho gusto" means:
questions.explanation: "Mucho gusto" literally means "much pleasure" — used when meeting someone.

questions.question: How do you say "I speak a little Spanish"?

questions.situation: A customer speaks too fast and you don't catch what they said.
questions.explanation: When you don't understand, politely ask them to speak more slowly.

questions.instruction: Put these words in order: "Good morning, how can I help you?"
questions.answer: Buenos días, ¿en qué le puedo ayudar?

questions.question: How do you say "Where are you from?" (formal)
questions.explanation: "¿De dónde es usted?" is the formal way to ask someone's origin.

questions.situation: A customer says "Muchas gracias" after you help them find an item.
questions.explanation: "Con mucho gusto" (with pleasure) + "¿Algo más?" (anything else?) is the perfect warm response.
